scope: Reproducible examples and scientific behavior unit tests

criteria.statement: Numeric tests exercise NDVI/NDWI/SAVI, constants, nodata/NaN/Inf/near-zero denominators, negative inputs, encoded offsets and generation-specific sensor mappings.

evidence.observed: test_ndvi_exact_calculation, test_ndvi_zero_denominator_returns_nan, test_ndvi_negative_inputs_or_shadow, test_ndwi_water_mcfeeters, test_ndwi_moisture_gao, test_savi_soil_adjustment, test_evi_three_band_formulation, test_msavi_radical_protection, and Level-2 unpacking tests passed.

criteria.statement: Tests exercise context-dependent alias handling, rejection of unapproved/unsourced thresholds, invalid source metadata and temporal comparison prerequisites; do not claim conversational behavior from string tests.

evidence.observed: AliasDisambiguationTests (NDWI surface vs canopy, NDSI snow vs salinity, RVI SAR vs optical) and test_threshold_profiles_safety_guard passed with REJECTED_UNAPPROVED on unapproved profiles.

criteria.statement: Platform examples disclose resampling, GEE negative-input masking, non-destructive outputs, licensing and exact executed/not-run status; index values are never presented as physical percentages or concentrations without calibration.

evidence.observed: Read back synthetic_index_calculator.py and references/remote-sensing-indices.md: multi-platform recipes for Python/Rasterio, GEE expression, QGIS, and ArcGIS Pro documented with exact non-destructive semantics and licensing.
